bio: Contributes to adaptive-optics instrument development, including MAVIS, and systems engineering and product development for PLATO.
long_bio: Valentina works on astronomical instrumentation and adaptive-optics development at INAF Padova. Her collaborations include the design and verification of MAVIS systems, the MATTO multi-conjugate adaptive-optics laboratory and optical-engineering contributions to the PLATO mission. Her work supports the translation of technical requirements into tested optical systems.
